title: One Time Launch Funnel Everything Setup

source_statements.source_statement: Create or continue the Codex goal, preserve the raw packet, create the launch-funnel requirement register, run the execution CLI, and keep evidence-based terminal statuses.
Campaign traffic should go to https://onetimeonetime.com/?utm_source=email&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=free_mishnayos_class, not the academy URL or direct Zoom.
/one-time is an internal fallback and /rabbi is a legacy or alias route that should remain compatible.
The launch funnel needs a usable One Time landing page, signup form, and CTA for the 30-day free Mishnayos class.
Signup must create or update scoped first-party One Time lead/contact tracking, not GHL or shared BNA data.
The user receives 30 days of free access from signup.
The member flow should take a signer-up user to a member/classroom page instead of exposing Zoom directly.
Send a confirmation email after signup and prepare a reminder sequence without bulk campaign sending.
Prepare class reminder automation metadata, but final live schedule and details still require operator approval.
Set up WhatsApp through Whapi/WAPI when credentials and number are available, but do not send WhatsApp messages in this packet.
Harden WhatsApp phonebook and communication scoping so One Time, BNA, and unrelated data do not mix.
Prepare Buffer/social setup state without publishing social posts from this packet.
Prepare the Vimeo, Drive, and OBS class-recording pipeline and check Vimeo credential readiness safely.
Define a secure Zoom/class-link model where the link is gated to member/class pages and final Zoom details remain operator-owned.
Audit existing paying users before any migration and do not cancel, refund, or change subscriptions in this packet.
The real campaign cannot send until final copy, final recipient list or segment, links, and explicit final send approval are supplied.
Run tests, smokes, screenshots, deployment proof, and final audit evidence before marking app-visible or server-visible work done.
Do not print or commit secrets, mutate DNS, add GHL, run Stripe, send WhatsApp, send imported leads, bulk-send a campaign, or mix BNA and One Time records.
